about.title: Santa Clara Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because another person was careless, the family is left to handle grief and paperwork all at once. In Santa Clara, four people lost their lives in traffic collisions during 2025, out of 367 injury crashes recorded citywide. Some of those collisions happened along El Camino Real, Lafayette Street, San Tomas Expressway and Monroe Street, the corridors with the highest volume of reported crashes in the city. Not every wrongful death claim begins on a road, though. A fall at a job site, a medical error, or a defective product can lead to the same kind of civil case. California lets a spouse or domestic partner and children bring the claim first, followed by certain heirs and dependents. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and it shortens when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is a free service. We listen to what happened and connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases in Santa Clara County on contingency, so there is no fee unless something is recovered.

whyChoose.title: Why Santa Clara Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits standing in a wrongful death case, with a spouse or domestic partner and children first in line, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who belongs in the claim before anything is filed.

items.title: The Clock Is Watched Closely
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death to act, and far less time if a city, county or state agency may share responsibility. Connecting early keeps those options open.

items.title: Losses Counted in Full
items.desc: A wrongful death claim can seek funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Nothing is promised, but nothing should be overlooked either.

items.question: The crash happened on San Tomas Expressway. Does that change anything about our case?
items.answer: It might. If there is any question about road design, signals or maintenance, a public agency could become part of the claim, and claims against government entities in California carry a much shorter filing window than the usual two years. An attorney can look at the collision report and decide quickly whether that shorter deadline applies to your family.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Santa Clara County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action, and it can move forward whether or not prosecutors file charges or secure a conviction. Many families pursue both paths at the same time, and evidence from the criminal case can sometimes be useful in the civil one.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive or to hire the attorney you connect us with?
items.answer: LawProactive is free. The independent attorneys in our network take wrongful death cases on contingency, which means there is no attorney fee unless money is recovered for your family. You can ask the attorney to explain the arrangement in writing before you decide anything.
